data.title: 神罚 · 细雨午后的慵懒被窝
data.description: 窗外细雨蒙蒙打在微凉的玻璃上，昏暗温暖的卧室内弥漫着静谧香气。神罚身穿浅灰色落肩针织短裙，雪白柔顺的短发略显凌乱，单肩滑落露出精致白皙的锁骨与香肩。她蜷坐在柔软白被间，微红着双颊抱膝凝望镜头，深红色的眼眸中满是纯真的依恋与少女的隐秘娇羞。
data.location: dimly lit cozy bedroom with rain on window
data.action: sitting on bed hugging knees, off-shoulder grey knit dress slipping off one shoulder, bare collarbone, messy silver bob hair, deep red eyes, gentle blush, looking at viewer
data.lighting: soft diffused rainy daylight from window mixed with warm bedside glow
data.mood: cozy domestic intimacy, gentle vulnerable affection
data.promptProse: Sitting on a soft bed tangled in white sheets on a rainy afternoon, Modernia wears an off-shoulder grey knit sweater dress with one bare shoulder exposed. Her silver bob hair is pleasantly tousled and her cheeks are flushed with a sweet, devoted gaze.
data.animaCaption: Modernia relaxing on the bed in an off-shoulder knit dress on a rainy day, blushing softly.
